bio: In good weather, you can take in breathtaking views up here at 2 181m above sea level. This down-to-earth Mountain Club restaurant appeals to diners of all ages. You can look forward to good food and a great wine selection, as well as a relaxed atmosphere, partly thanks to the music and DJs. Note: there is an entry fee for non-members. Accessible by chairlift and a short walk (10min)....
